title: Shopping for Dinner
text:
Maria goes to the supermarket on Friday. She has a shopping list. The list has rice, tomatoes, cheese and milk. She buys everything quickly.

On Sunday, Carlos goes shopping with his sister. They need bread and eggs for breakfast. Carlos wants ice cream, but his sister says no. They buy the food and go home.

questions.text: What is on Maria's shopping list?
What do Carlos and his sister need for breakfast?
Why does Maria buy everything quickly?
options: She knows exactly what she needs
She does not like the supermarket
She is buying food for a party

questions.text: What can we guess about Carlos?

vocabulary.definition: a paper with the things you want to buy
in a fast way, without spending much time
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a cold, sweet food made from milk and sugar

paragraph_translations: María va al supermercado el viernes. Tiene una lista de la compra. La lista tiene arroz, tomates, queso y leche. Compra todo rápidamente.
El domingo, Carlos va de compras con su hermana. Necesitan pan y huevos para el desayuno. Carlos quiere helado, pero su hermana dice que no. Compran la comida y vuelven a casa.
